derivation.behavior: Superseded Kotlin transfer/media/scheduler/persistence authority is absent from Android entry points.
derivation.canonical_behavior: Android notification, service, ViewModel, scheduler and persistence ingress surfaces submit commands or facts to Go; Kotlin retains only narrow platform side effects and compatibility metadata helpers.

invariants: Android UI and notification surfaces cannot directly decide queue eligibility, retry policy, or transfer starts.
WorkManager, FGS, UIDT and boot/package primitives only host or wake Go scheduling authority.
The Android execution broker performs side effects only after a Go command and does not own scheduler/media policy.
Legacy Room remains a one-time import source rather than a parallel authoritative state writer.
